title: QUIET, EASY TO USE, NICE ATTRACTIVE UNIT
text: QUIET, EASY TO USE, NICE ATTRACTIVE UNIT. The last humidifier I used before this one was very old technology and it made too much noise.  This unit runs so quietly that you cannot hear it; even the moisture that it emits comes out silently.  I have had some trouble getting the buttons on the unit to respond, but eventually they work.  It was hard to tell if I was getting low or high mist.  The unit shuts off when it runs out of water, which is good.  When I first got this, the tank had a strange odor, so perhaps I should have washed it out once before using it.  The only thing I didn't really like too much about this unit is the amount of water it uses.  If I could use tap water, that would be no big deal, but our water is so hard that it would mess up the unit in no time.  I have to use distilled water and on the high setting it only runs two nights before having to fill it again.  Distilled water is not expensive, but it runs about 50 cents a day using it on the high setting.  The manual says about 50 hours of operation on the low setting, but it didn't seem like I was getting anywhere near that amount of time.  I suppose to get a good amount of moisture in the air in my dry climate it needs to use a good amount of water, but I may have to buy a lot more distilled water each trip to the store.  I already use distilled water for other purposes, so now will have to buy more.  Anyway, it is a nice unit and if you need moisture in the air, this does a great job.

product_metadata.title: Pure Enrichment HumeXL Ultrasonic Cool Mist Humidifier for Large Rooms Lasts up to 50 hours, Easy-to-Clean 1.3 Gallon Water Tank, Touch-Button Control, 2 Independent 360° Mist Nozzles and Night Mode
features: AROUND-THE-CLOCK MOISTURE: Produces up to 50 hours of continuous mist output on the low setting and up to 16 hours on high to provide all day comfort in your home or office – automatically shuts off when when the water level is low or the water tank is removed.

INTUITIVE TOUCH-BUTTON CONTROL: Sleek, touch-button panel lets you easily power the unit on and off, control mist output with high/low mist settings, and activate night mode to dim the LED control panel and turn off the soft glow night light while you sleep.

2 INDEPENDENT MIST NOZZLES: Direct the independent, 360-degree rotating mist nozzles in opposite directions for diverse room coverage or point both in the same direction for more powerful steam output.
EASY-CLEAN WATER TANK: Large opening on the 5-liter water tank makes it easy to hand wash the inside of the tank to remove buildup and keep the humidifier operating at maximum efficiency.

WHAT YOU GET: ETL-Approved Humidifier, user manual, industry-leading 5 Year Warranty, caring customer support 7 days a week, and the peace of mind that comes from a trusted brand with millions of customers worldwide.
